module: Global filter camera (isGlobal, isFilter, hidden, runningOrder 0.6) that guarantees data.res.pos and data.res.rot are set: if no camera provided a position or rotation, it takes the vehicle position (data.pos) and the direction toward data.pos. The module returns a constructor: local cam = require('core/cameraModes/fallback')(options).
notes: All camera modes follow this pattern: a constructor returning an object of class C with C:init() and C:update(data); data is the camData table built by core_cameraUpdate (data.res = pos/rot/fov/targetPos/nearClip result, data.dt, data.veh, data.pos...).

C.desc: Class of the fallback camera mode.

update.desc: Fills data.res.pos and data.res.rot if they are nil.
